   2:
   3: mount -t proc proc proc
   4:
   5: /sbin/ifconfig lo 127.0.0.1 up
   6:
   7: mount -t ramfs ramfs /ramdisk
   8: mkdir -m 777 /ramdisk/var
   9: mkdir -m 777 /ramdisk/var/run
  10: mkdir -m 777 /ramdisk/var/log
  11: mkdir -m 777 /ramdisk/tmp
  12: mkdir -m 777 /ramdisk/tmp/pub
  13: mkdir -m 777 /ramdisk/optlog
  14: mkdir -m 777 /ramdisk/smb
  15:
  16: if [ -f /bin/repartition.sh ]; then
  17:   sh /bin/repartition.sh
  18: fi
  19:
  20: mount -t jffs2 -o noatime /dev/nandjffs /jffs
  21: if [ $? -ne 0 ]
  22: then
  23:     if [ -f /bin/formatjffs ]; then
  24:         echo "Reformat jffs" >> /opt/log/repartition.log
  25:         /bin/formatjffs
  26:         mount -t jffs2 -o noatime /dev/nandjffs /jffs
  27:     fi
  28: fi
  29:
  30: /etc/init.d/Srandom
  31:
  32: /sbin/insmod /modules/chk_driver.o
  33: /sbin/insmod /modules/audiodev.o
  34:
  35: /wifi/netstartd --resetcheckonly
  36:
  37: if [ -f /jffs/Configure ]; then
  38:   echo "Running custom Configure..."
  39:   exec /jffs/Configure
  40: fi
  41:
  42: echo 262143 > /proc/sys/net/core/rmem_max
  43: echo 0 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts
  44:
  45: echo 32768 36863 > /proc/sys/net/ipv4/ip_local_port_range
  46:
  47: /bin/mdputil -B
  48:
  49: wifiType=N
  50:
  51: /sbin/insmod /wifi/$wifiType/ath_hal.o
  52: /sbin/insmod /wifi/$wifiType/ath_driver.o
  53:
  54: if [ -e /wifi/bridge-ppc.o ]; then
  55:     /sbin/insmod /wifi/bridge-ppc.o
  56: fi
  57:
  58: /usr/sbin/setmac
  59:
  60: touch /var/run/waitforip
  61:
  62: if [ -f /etc/unlocked_build_flag -o -e /jffs/system/Configure.dev ]; then
  63:     /usr/sbin/inetd
  64:
  65:     ln -s /opt/htdocs_locked /tmp/htdocs_locked
  66:
  67:     touch /tmp/device_unlocked_flag
  68: fi
  69:
  70: if [ -f /jffs/system/Configure.dev ]; then
  71:     sh /jffs/system/Configure.dev
  72: fi
  73:
  74: if [ -f /jffs/hosts ]; then
  75:     touch /jffs/hosts
  76: else
  77:     cp /etc/hosts.orig /jffs/hosts
  78: fi
  79:
  80: echo "Configure script complete."

IMAGE buildroot
unsquashfs -cat /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/out/rootfs.squashfs etc/inittab
   1: # /etc/inittab -- Moggie
   2: #
   3: # PID 1 is busybox init. rcS does all one-shot setup; sonosd is respawned by
   4: # init so a crash restarts it (busybox init throttles runaway respawns).
   5: #
   6: # The console runs a shell directly: root's password is locked in /etc/shadow
   7: # and no password-authenticated login exists anywhere on the device. Physical
   8: # UART access is the trust boundary. SSH is opt-in and key-only; see rcS.
   9:
  10: ::sysinit:/etc/init.d/rcS
  11:
  12: ttyS0::respawn:/sbin/getty -L -l /bin/sh 115200 ttyS0 vt100
  13:
  14: ::respawn:/usr/sbin/sonosd
  15:
  16: ::restart:/sbin/init
  17: ::ctrlaltdel:/sbin/reboot
  18: ::shutdown:/bin/umount -a -r
  19: ::shutdown:/bin/sync

unsquashfs -cat /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/out/rootfs.squashfs etc/init.d/rcS
   1: #!/bin/sh
   2: #
   3: # Moggie first-stage init -- runs as PID 1's sysinit from /etc/inittab.
   4: #
   5: # POSIX sh, busybox ash compatible. Must work with:
   6: #   * no network
   7: #   * a read-only squashfs root
   8: #   * a 2.6.35 kernel with no CONFIG_DEVTMPFS and no CONFIG_SQUASHFS_XATTRS
   9: #
  10: # sonosd itself is respawned by init (see /etc/inittab), not started here.
  11:
  12: PATH=/sbin:/usr/sbin:/bin:/usr/bin
  13: export PATH
  14:
  15: log() { echo "moggie: $*"; }
  16:
  17: # --- pseudo filesystems ---------------------------------------------------
  18: mount -t proc  proc  /proc 2>/dev/null || log "proc: mount failed"
  19: mount -t sysfs sysfs /sys  2>/dev/null || log "sysfs: mount failed"
  20:
  21: for d in /tmp /run /var/log; do
  22:     [ -d "$d" ] || mkdir -p "$d" 2>/dev/null
  23: done
  24: mount -t tmpfs -o mode=1777,nosuid,nodev tmpfs /tmp     2>/dev/null || log "tmpfs /tmp: mount failed"
  25: mount -t tmpfs -o mode=0755,nosuid,nodev tmpfs /run     2>/dev/null || log "tmpfs /run: mount failed"
  26: mount -t tmpfs -o mode=0755,nosuid,nodev tmpfs /var/log 2>/dev/null || log "tmpfs /var/log: mount failed"
  27:
  28: # --- /dev -----------------------------------------------------------------
  29: # The shipped 2.6.35 kernel was built without CONFIG_DEVTMPFS, so the image
  30: # carries static nodes and this script layers tmpfs + mdev on top. If a
  31: # future kernel does provide devtmpfs, use it instead.
  32: if grep -qw devtmpfs /proc/filesystems 2>/dev/null; then
  33:     mount -t devtmpfs devtmpfs /dev 2>/dev/null && log "/dev: devtmpfs"
  34: else
  35:     mount -t tmpfs -o mode=0755,nosuid tmpfs /dev 2>/dev/null && log "/dev: tmpfs + mdev"
  36: fi
  37:
  38: # Minimum nodes mdev needs before it can run; also the fallback if the tmpfs
  39: # mount above failed and we are still looking at the read-only image /dev.
  40: [ -c /dev/console ] || mknod -m 600 /dev/console c 5 1 2>/dev/null
  41: [ -c /dev/null ]    || mknod -m 666 /dev/null    c 1 3 2>/dev/null
  42: [ -c /dev/zero ]    || mknod -m 666 /dev/zero    c 1 5 2>/dev/null
  43:
  44: if [ -x /sbin/mdev ]; then
  45:     mdev -s 2>/dev/null || log "mdev: scan failed"
  46: fi
  47:
  48: # --- identity -------------------------------------------------------------
  49: if [ -r /etc/hostname ]; then
  50:     read -r HN < /etc/hostname 2>/dev/null
  51:     [ -n "$HN" ] && hostname "$HN" 2>/dev/null
  52: fi
  53:
  54: # --- persistent state -----------------------------------------------------
  55: # docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: mtd0 u-boot, mtd1 jffs2 (7 MB), mtd2 ramdisk,
  56: # mtd3 rootfs A/B, mtd4 kernel, mtd5 dtb. A missing or unformatted jffs2
  57: # must not stop the boot.
  58: mkdir -p /jffs 2>/dev/null
  59: if [ -b /dev/mtdblock1 ]; then
  60:     if ! mount -t jffs2 /dev/mtdblock1 /jffs 2>/dev/null; then
  61:         log "/jffs: not mounted (unformatted or no jffs2 support)"
  62:     fi
  63: else
  64:     log "/jffs: /dev/mtdblock1 absent"
  65: fi
  66:
  67: # --- network (best effort) ------------------------------------------------
  68: if [ -d /sys/class/net/lo ]; then
  69:     ip link set lo up 2>/dev/null || ifconfig lo up 2>/dev/null
  70: fi
  71:
  72: if [ -d /sys/class/net/eth0 ]; then
  73:     ip link set eth0 up 2>/dev/null || ifconfig eth0 up 2>/dev/null
  74:     (
  75:         if command -v udhcpc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  76:             udhcpc -i eth0 -n -q -t 4 -T 3 \
  77:                    -s /usr/share/udhcpc/default.script >/dev/null 2>&1
  78:         fi
  79:         if ! ip addr show dev eth0 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'inet '; then
  80:             # No DHCP server on the wire. 169.254/16 is deliberate: a
  81:             # hard-coded 192.168.x address could collide with the LAN.
  82:             if ip addr add 169.254.10.1/16 dev eth0 2>/dev/null; then
  83:                 log "eth0: no DHCP lease, link-local 169.254.10.1/16"
  84:             else
  85:                 log "eth0: no DHCP lease and no static fallback"
  86:             fi
  87:         else
  88:             log "eth0: DHCP lease acquired"
  89:         fi
  90:     ) &
  91: fi
  92:
  93: # --- ssh (opt-in, key-only) -----------------------------------------------
  94: # dropbear is installed but silent by default. To enable it, put on the
  95: # jffs2 partition:  /jffs/ssh/enable  /jffs/ssh/host_key  /jffs/ssh/authorized_keys
  96: # Password authentication is disabled unconditionally (-s).
  97: if [ -r /jffs/ssh/enable ] && [ -r /jffs/ssh/host_key ] \
  98:    && [ -r /jffs/ssh/authorized_keys ]; then
  99:     mkdir -p /root/.ssh 2>/dev/null
 100:     cp /jffs/ssh/authorized_keys /root/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null
 101:     chmod 700 /root/.ssh 2>/dev/null
 102:     chmod 600 /root/.ssh/authorized_keys 2>/dev/null
 103:     if /usr/sbin/dropbear -s -p 22 -r /jffs/ssh/host_key 2>/dev/null; then
 104:         log "sshd: listening on :22 (key only)"
 105:     else
 106:         log "sshd: failed to start"
 107:     fi
 108: else
 109:     log "sshd: disabled (provision /jffs/ssh/{enable,host_key,authorized_keys})"
 110: fi
 111:
 112: log "boot complete"

unsquashfs -cat /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/out/rootfs.squashfs etc/fstab
   1: # /etc/fstab -- Moggie
   2: #
   3: # Most of this is mounted explicitly by rcS; the file exists so `mount -a`
   4: # and `mount` output agree with reality. /jffs is mtd1 (see the flash map in
   5: # docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) and is only mounted if it is present and formatted.
   6:
   7: proc		/proc		proc		defaults		0 0
   8: sysfs		/sys		sysfs		defaults		0 0
   9: tmpfs		/dev		tmpfs		mode=0755,nosuid	0 0
  10: tmpfs		/tmp		tmpfs		mode=1777,nosuid	0 0
  11: tmpfs		/run		tmpfs		mode=0755,nosuid	0 0
  12: tmpfs		/var/log	tmpfs		mode=0755,nosuid	0 0
  13: /dev/mtdblock1	/jffs		jffs2		rw,noatime		0 0

unsquashfs -cat /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/out/rootfs.squashfs etc/passwd
   1: root:<redacted>:0:0:root:/root:/bin/sh
   2: daemon:<redacted>:1:1:daemon:/usr/sbin:/bin/false
   3: nobody:<redacted>:65534:65534:nobody:/nonexistent:/bin/false

   2: daemon:x:1:
   3: tty:x:5:
   4: disk:x:6:
   5: audio:x:18:
   6: nogroup:x:65534:

unsquashfs -cat /home/ben/Moggie-wt/buildroot/out/rootfs.squashfs etc/moggie-release

   2: MOGGIE_BUILDROOT_SHA256=unknown
   3: MOGGIE_TOOLCHAIN=unknown
   4: MOGGIE_SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=1700000000
   5: MOGGIE_GIT_COMMIT=unknown
   6: MOGGIE_TARGET=powerpc-e300c3-linux-gnu (big endian, hard float)

   4: #

  62:     fi
  63: else
  64:     log "/jffs: /dev/mtdblock1 absent"
  65: fi
  66:
  67: # --- network (best effort) ------------------------------------------------
  68: if [ -d /sys/class/net/lo ]; then

  84:             else
  85:                 log "eth0: no DHCP lease and no static fallback"
  86:             fi
  87:         else
  88:             log "eth0: DHCP lease acquired"
  89:         fi

  98:    && [ -r /jffs/ssh/authorized_keys ]; then
